Firebase JavaScript SDK 9.23.0 — compatibility builds

These are the same SDK version used by the previous app, bundled locally so
app startup does not require fetching scripts from Google's CDN.

Original unmodified sources:
https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.23.0/firebase-app-compat.js
https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.23.0/firebase-auth-compat.js
https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.23.0/firebase-firestore-compat.js
